title: Ground and aerial photo matching sheet
subject: Geography
unit: Summer 1: The UK, its capitals and London (Bright Lights, Big City)
source: Seeded from geography/y1 lesson 6 (Ground and aerial photo matching sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 6: London landmarks from the air. To understand how aerial photographs show London's landmarks from above

model.title: Find Tower Bridge on the aerial photo

parts.label: Step 3
parts.text: Look for a bridge with two towers

questions.q: What crosses the river: a bridge or a dome?
questions.model: A river is water. To cross it we need something to walk or drive on. That is a bridge.

questions.q: Which landmark is a big wheel?
Match four ground photos to their aerial photos on the sheet.
questions.a: Tower Bridge, London Eye, St Paul's Cathedral, Big Ben's tower matched
questions.model: Teacher matches Tower Bridge first: two towers, crossing the river.

questions.q: Draw the River Thames and put Tower Bridge on it.
questions.a: A wavy river line with a bridge across it

questions.q: Why is a river a good clue on a map?
questions.a: It is long and easy to see, so you can follow it

questions.q: Big question: how do you find a landmark from the sky?
questions.a: Look for big shapes and clues like the river, then match them
